name: loopd-mod-signal
displayName: loopd — signal (a mod that tells the PM session a role agent's turn is over)
description: COMPANION, a mod. In a bundle root it records this session as the bundle's project-manager under loopd.pm.<bundle root> in the plugin store. In a role agent's worktree it resolves the bundle through the .git/loopd-bundle marker on every turn.complete, writes loopd.signal.<session id> to the store, and sends the PM session ONE line — `loopd-signal: role session <id> finished a turn …` — the same delivery as the SendMessage tool. The line orders step 4's sweep and decides nothing: no task document is read, no status is written, no prompt is submitted, the message is never consumed. No model call, no permission decision, no process, no network, no environment, no file write. Not installed = step 4 reads sessions exactly as before.
